name: Pyongyang Kwangmyong Information Technology Corporation facilitator model in Russia

attribution.legal_posture: UN Panel reporting; some claims reproduce Member State information and remain outside criminal adjudication.

caveats: The named platform is retained only as historical context; attribution requires additional source evidence.
The Russian Federation replied that the company was not locally registered and that it had no data on the people involved.

statements: A Member State reported that Pyongyang Kwangmyong IT Corporation operated in Vladivostok and used Russian nationals to create and remotely verify freelance-platform accounts, receive worker payments into Russian bank accounts, identify work, and provide banking services for a share of worker revenue.

sources.support: Supports the exact company, Vladivostok location, local-facilitator account/banking model and Russian response
